title: High-Temperature Oxidation and Phase Stability of AlCrCoFeNi High Entropy Alloy: Insights from In Situ HT-XRD and Thermodynamic Calculations.

recollection.mechanism: guess: thermally activated diffusion and reaction
recollection.results: guess: increased oxidation resistance and phase stability at high temperatures

score.note: The recollection only restates the broad high-temperature oxidation treatment and generically mentions oxide layers and diffusion/reaction. It omits the air-versus-vacuum comparison, in situ heating to 1100 °C, CALPHAD analysis, specific BCC/B2–FCC–sigma phase evolution, selective Al/Cr oxidation and duplex alumina/chromia scale mechanism, and all quantitative temperatures and scale thicknesses. The claimed increased oxidation resistance and phase stability is not a specific reported result.
